newsitem.title: FRANCE: Bank of France injects 4.3 bln Ffr at tender.
newsitem.headline: Bank of France injects 4.3 bln Ffr at tender.

text.p: The Bank of France injected 4.3 billion francs at a securities repurchase tender held on Monday to allocate funds for injection into the money market on Tuesday.
It accepted bids for 46.5 billion francs in new liquidity, 4.3 billion more than the 42.2 billion leaving the market on Tuesday when a previous pact expires. The new pact expires on February 18.
The Bank of France said it allocated 13.9 billion francs to bidders offering Treasury bills as collateral, satisfying 4.2 percent of such demand.
It allotted a further 32.6 billion to bidders putting up private paper, satisfying 14.2 percent of this demand.
